topic: Koby Heard Every Voice At Marineford
title: Koby Heard Every Voice At Marineford
description: Koby awakened Observation Haki at Marineford with no training, in chapters 579 and 594. The detail about what he did with it is why fans call him the future of the Marines.
comment: Did Koby awaken Haki from fear, or from refusing to look away? Pick one.

lines.text: Koby never learned Haki. Marineford forced it into his head.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Koby with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Chapter 579. He wakes up in the middle of the war, still weak.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Koby with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Suddenly he hears every person on the battlefield, like voices inside his own skull.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Koby with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Chapter 594 gives it a name. Observation Haki, awakened by shock, with zero training.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Koby with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So he screams at both sides to stop throwing lives away for a war with no purpose left.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Koby with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Helmeppo is jealous. Koby never even knew Haki existed.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Koby with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: The easy objection is that it was only trauma, and fear alone woke him.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Koby with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: But plenty of terrified Marines stood on that field. Only one refused to look away.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Koby with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Years later he shatters Pizarro's giant island hand with advanced Armament Haki, in chapter 1088.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Koby with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: He heard strangers that day. So what opened Luffy's ears, back when nobody had taught him anything?

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Koby with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Which is why Koby never learned Haki, and Marineford forced it into his head.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Koby with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text
